name: MainnetSettler
fix_description: In basicSellToPool, arbitrary calls are made to user-specified pool with user-specified data. The _isRestrictedTarget check is insufficient - it does not cover token contracts. Attacker sets pool=token and data=transferFrom(victim,attacker,amount). Fix: validate data selector is not transferFrom/transfer/approve, or whitelist allowed pool addresses.
difficulty_reasoning: The PoC is a very short, essentially single-transaction exploit that directly abuses crafted calldata against the target contract without flash loans, routing complexity, or deep protocol-state reasoning. An experienced auditor could reproduce this quickly once they spot the arbitrary call/validation issue, so it fits the easy bucket.
